dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Sale Shines, Braves Edge Padres in Thrilling Finish**

Chris Sale dominated on the mound, tossing six scoreless innings with 11 strikeouts to lead the Atlanta Braves to a 6-5 win over the San Diego Padres. Dominic Smith's three-RBI performance, including a homer, was not enough for the Padres, who saw Ty France's 16th home run of the season sail over the left-field wall. In the Twins' 3-1 victory over the Guardians, Patrick Bailey's solo homer was the difference-maker for Minnesota. Meanwhile, in the Blue Jays' 3-1 win over the Rays, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. singled home a crucial run to seal the deal.
